stage: AI-player architecture development; native player and playthrough qualification pending

decisions.D1: Server installation required; client mod optional. Ordinary-client compatibility remains a qualification target.
decisions.D2: Fabric on Minecraft Java 1.21.1; selected as initial bounded target
decisions.D3: Optional Claude/OpenAI APIs with operator-supplied keys; disabled by default. A Claude strategist for goals (F-19b, Anthropic Java SDK) can be switched on through the server's environment; the SDK is on the development classpath only, not yet in the release jar. No Jev or mandatory hosted orchestration.
decisions.D4: Autonomous block edits are off by default; a missing edits.properties means off. With them off an AI player still keeps itself alive without changing a block: it eats, steps out of fire, lava and deep water and away from a creeper, and defends itself from a mob that is on it. An operator may record the roaming-edit policy with /aiplayer edits on: survival breaking and placing where the player itself may edit, never containers or block entities other than its own empty furnace, never spawn-protected blocks, never a lava-releasing break.
decisions.D5: Unattended progression requires qualified player mechanics, activity admission and recovery.
decisions.D6: A game mode may hand out an item only by an announced rule identical for human and AI participants (Manhunt tracking compass). No other exception to earned progress in survival modes. Implemented for manhunts (M-02a): the rule announced at the start, one compass to every hunter, cursed to vanish on death, taken back when the hunt ends; native fixtures between AI players.
decisions.D7: AI players attack humans only inside a match the human joined; otherwise player attacks stay refused. Enforced for every strike at a player by duel matches (M-00a: a human joins only for itself, an AI player is entered by its administrator, and only with the server's PvP on), in native fixtures between AI players; a human-joined duel is not yet qualified in play.
decisions.D8: Schematics are bundled when their licenses allow or supplied by users as files or single links, with license and attribution kept; no bulk scraping. Not implemented.

modelConfiguration.provider: Optional, operator key (F-19d): Anthropic (claude-haiku-5-5), OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini), Gemini (gemini-3.5-flash-lite), Groq (openai/gpt-oss-20b), Mistral (mistral-small-latest), DeepSeek (deepseek-chat), xAI (model named), OpenRouter (openai/gpt-4o-mini) or any OpenAI-compatible server (KINDRED_STRATEGIST_BASE_URL)
modelConfiguration.enabledBy: KINDRED_STRATEGIST=on and one provider's key in the server environment (or KINDRED_STRATEGIST_API_KEY, recognised by prefix, or KINDRED_STRATEGIST_PROVIDER)
modelConfiguration.defaultModel: claude-haiku-5-5 with an Anthropic key; each provider's own default otherwise
modelConfiguration.use: Goal strategist: a stance, places to avoid and a focus on what comes next, notes that may teach habits kept per world (F-19c), and up to three follow-ups for the player's queue (F-19e), all from fixed sets validated in core; never actions, items or code
modelConfiguration.guide: companion-model/src/main/resources/dev/kindred/model/minecraft-guide.md, sent after the instructions on every request and cached (F-19e)
modelConfiguration.bounds: 15 s deadline, no repair, one in flight per player, 6/min per player and 12/min in all; pace steady (default: big changes, daily tokens 50,000 per player and 100,000 in all) or realtime (every 10 s at most and on new events, advice for a minute, daily tokens 5,000,000 and 10,000,000), cached input counted for a tenth, KINDRED_STRATEGIST_PACE and the budget variables
modelConfiguration.bundledInReleaseJar: the OpenAI-compatible providers yes (JDK HTTP client and Minecraft's Gson); the Anthropic SDK no
modelConfiguration.voice: Replies in chat phrased by the same model (E-20a): told only what each listener may know (core's ConversationAudience), said through the social lane's own checks; chat lane 8 s, one JSON-mode repair, 120 output tokens, at most 240 characters, refused if a command, formatting codes, unclean or a place for a non-controller; the same rates and daily budgets as the strategist; any failure the fixed reply; KINDRED_VOICE=off keeps the fixed replies
modelConfiguration.requestSettings: low effort, thinking off, instructions and guide cached (about 2.5 s a question, about 4,500 of its 4,700 to 5,100 input tokens from the cache; KINDRED_STRATEGIST_EFFORT, KINDRED_STRATEGIST_THINKING)

architecture.productionGoal: Three artificial players earning a cooperative survival playthrough through the Ender Dragon
architecture.defaultBossPolicy: Unqualified encounters blocked; qualified team Dragon progression is a production objective
architecture.dependencyPolicy: Prefer free/open-source components; optional operator-funded model API usage
architecture.currentBodyBackend: NativePlayerBody through explicit development commands; CompanionEntity legacy compatibility
